## Before you begin

- The shop app is open on the shop tablet or computer.

## Procedure

1. Find the Welcome screen. It shows the shop's logo, the heading **Who's
   grooming?**, and one button for each staff member.

   ![The Welcome screen](/screenshots/shared/welcome.png)

2. Click the button with your name on it. The Check-in screen opens.

## Result

The Check-in screen is open. At the top right of the screen, your name
appears after **Grooming:**.

![The Check-in screen, signed in as Tanya](/screenshots/groomer/dog-list.png)

::: {.callout-important}
## Always sign in as yourself
The Welcome screen does not ask for a password. Click only your own name. The
name after **Grooming:** is recorded on everything done on the screen until
someone switches profiles.
:::

## Switching to another profile

When another staff member takes over the tablet or computer:

1. Click **Switch** at the top right of the screen. The Welcome screen opens.
2. The next staff member clicks the button with their own name on it. The
   Check-in screen opens under their name.
